messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- The nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- The indexer's incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team reported that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2026-06-08, for the Team Dune on-call cycle, page Farah for anything instead of Tomasz Nowak. [preference; valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, for the Team Dune on-call cycle, page Tomasz Nowak for anything instead of Farah. [preference; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-08; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-10, for the Team Dune on-call cycle, page Farah for anything instead of Tomasz Nowak. [preference; valid 2026-03-10 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-04, for the current Team Dune on-call cycle, page Tomasz Nowak for anything instead of Farah. [preference; valid 2026-02-04 to 2026-03-10; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
    earlier: As of 2025-12-15, for the current Team Dune on-call cycle, page Farah for anything instead of Tomasz Nowak. [preference; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-02-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-15]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-27, for the current Team Dune on-call cycle, page Tomasz Nowak for anything instead of Farah. [preference; valid 2025-10-27 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-22, Farah is primary on-call for Team Dune and Tomasz Nowak is off rotation. [valid 2025-09-22 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-22]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz Nowak is on call for Team Dune this cycle, having taken the pager from Farah. [valid 2025-07-30 to 2025-09-22; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-30]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-17, Farah is on call for Team Dune this cycle. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-17]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
- On 2026-05-04, Team Boreal decided that the event bus will retain messages for seven days, because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk, leaving stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]

Question: Why does search-indexer rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write?
